name: MPT
effectsSummary: FreeODwiki describes MPT as a poorly studied tryptamine with anecdotal effects; its oral dose/duration table contains only placeholders.
dosageRemark: The archived page's oral dose and duration values are placeholders ('???'), not usable measurements. It says toxicity and long-term recreational effects are unstudied and exact toxic dose unknown; no numeric dose bands are inferred.
generalRisks: The page says recreational toxicity and long-term health effects appear unstudied, exact toxic dose is unknown and human-use history is very limited.
longtermRisks: FreeODwiki says long-term recreational health effects have not been studied in a scientific context.
saferUse: FreeODwiki recommends independent research and harm reduction; the oral dose table is placeholder-only and must not be interpreted as quantitative guidance.
summary: MPT is a poorly studied tryptamine. Its archived oral dose and duration fields are placeholders, and human toxicity data are unavailable.
